metadata.name: CardActivation
metadata.description: Use this API to activate card by providing correct data in card validation parameter set on program.

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked Example: 1.3 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of sender Example:  10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source from where API Call is initiated. CoreCard have multiple value of source for internal system (CoreMoney, SelfService, IVR, MobileSelfService) For external system expected source will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller Id of source from where API is initiated. It is End User phone number. Example: 7204454214 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called Id of destination for which API is initiated. It is Corecard IVR number. Example: 7314145404 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: ANI
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: DNS
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Flag to retrieve error message in specific language Example: 'en' for English Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: RequestDate
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM-DD-YYYYTHH:MM:SS Example:- 11-12-2021T13:05:10 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: UniqueID
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: UniqueIDFlag
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 1

request_fields.name: CardNumber
request_fields.description: Clear Card Number of the cardholder Valid values: 0-9 Example: 123456******0001 Condition:At least one of Card Number/Proxy Number is required. Allowable Values: 16

request_fields.name: ProxyNumber
request_fields.description: Proxy Number of the cardholder Valid values:0-9 Example:1005 Condition:At least one of Card Number/Proxy Number is required. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: FirstName
request_fields.description: Cardholder First Name Valid Values: A-Z,a-z,special characters ( !@#$%^*()_+=-.) and Ampersand Example: Andrew Condition: This is required if validation parameter set on product as part of Full Name Allowable Values: 40

request_fields.name: MiddleName
request_fields.description: Cardholder Middle Name Valid Values: A-Z,a-z,special characters ( !@#$%^*()_+=-.) and Ampersand Example: Charles Condition: This is required if validation parameter set on product as part of Full Name Allowable Values: 40

request_fields.name: LastName
request_fields.description: Cardholder Last Name Valid Values: A-Z,a-z,special characters ( !@#$%^*()_+=-.) and Ampersand Example: Hudson Condition: This is required if validation parameter set on product as part of Full Name Allowable Values: 40

request_fields.name: AddressLine1
request_fields.description: Address Line 1 of the Cardholder Valid values : A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example: 15 Penang Street Point Condition : This is required if validation parameter set on product as Full Address. Both AddressLine1 and AddressLine2 is Mandatory. Allowable Values: 40

request_fields.name: AddressLine2
request_fields.description: Address Line 2 of the Cardholder Valid values: A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example: 1 mecca way Condition : This is required if validation parameter set on product as Full Address. Both AddressLine1 and AddressLine2 is Mandatory. Allowable Values: 40

request_fields.name: EmailAddress1
request_fields.description: E Mail Address 1 of Cardholder Valid Values: A-Z, a-z, 0-9 @ . Example: [email protected] Condition : This is required if validation parameter set on product as EMail One Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: DateOfBirth
request_fields.description: Date of Birth of cardholder Format: MM/DD/YYYY Valid Values: 0-9 Example:- 03/26/1986 Condition : This is required if validation parameter set on product as Birth Date Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: LanguageIndicator
request_fields.description: Language Indicator Valid Values:A-Z,a-z. Example: en, where en represents 'English' Condition : This is required if validation parameter set on product as Language Indicator Allowable Values: 5

request_fields.name: PostalCode
request_fields.description: Cardholder Postal Code of Residence Valid Values:A-Z,a-z,0-9 Example: 30093 Condition : This is required if validation parameter set on product as Postal Code Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: HomePhoneNumber
request_fields.description: Home Phone Number. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 9812338769 Condition : This is required if validation parameter set on product as Home Phone Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: WorkPhoneNumber
request_fields.description: Cardholder  Work Phone Number Valid values:0-9 Example:9632581470 Condition : This is required if validation parameter set on product as Work Phone Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: SocialSecurityNumber
request_fields.description: Social Security Number of Cardholder Valid Values:0-9 Example:123456789 Condition :This is required if validation parameter set on product as  Social Security Number of Cardholder. Allowable Values: 9

request_fields.name: CardExpiryDate
request_fields.description: Expiration Date of the card. Format is (MMYYYY). Valid Values: 0-9 Example : 092020 Condition : This is required if validation parameter set on product as Card Expiration Date Allowable Values: 6

request_fields.name: CurrentPIN
request_fields.description: Current Card PIN of four digits. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 1346 Condition : This is required if validation parameter set on product as Current PIN Allowable Values: 4

request_fields.name: CurrentPassword
request_fields.description: Current Password of Cardholder. Valid Values: A-Z, a-z,0-9, Special characters. Example: Test123! Condition : This is required if validation parameter set on product as Current Password Allowable Values: 9

request_fields.name: NewPIN
request_fields.description: Four Digit New PIN of the card Valid Values: 0-9 Example:1346 Condition : This is required if validation parameter set on product as New PIN Allowable Values: 4

request_fields.name: NewPassword
request_fields.description: New Password of Cardholder. Valid Values: A-Z, a-z,0-9, Special characters. Example: Test123! Condition : This is required if validation parameter set on product as New Password Allowable Values: 9

request_fields.name: IDNumber
request_fields.description: Last 4 Digits of Primary ID Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 4586 Condition : This is required if validation parameter set on product as Last 4 Digits of Primary ID Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CVV2
request_fields.description: Three digit printed on  the back of  the card. Valid Values - 0-9 Example: 213 Condition : This is required if validation parameter set on product as CVC2 Allowable Values: 4

request_fields.name: BirthYear
request_fields.description: Birth Year Of CardHolder Valid Values: 0-9 Example:1994 Condition : This is required if validation parameter set on product as Birth Year Allowable Values: 4

request_fields.name: CustomAccountID
request_fields.description: Any custom ID which is used to uniquely identify the Account. Valid values: A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example:123456789 Condition: This is required if validation parameter set on product as Custom Account ID Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: SSNLast4Digits
request_fields.description: Last 4 digits of Social Security Number of a Cardholder Valid values :0-9 Example: 6789 Condition : This is required if validation parameter set on product as Last 4 Digits of SSN Allowable Values: 4

request_fields.name: CIPCollectSSN
request_fields.description: Social Security Number of a Cardholder Valid values :0-9 Example: 123456788 Condition : This tag is required if validation parameter set on product as CIPCollectSSN

request_fields.name: CIPCollectIDType
request_fields.description: Type of ID. Valid Values: 0-12 Example 05 Appendix Section: ID Name Values Condition : This tag is required if validation parameter set on product as CIPCollectIDType

request_fields.name: CIPCollectIDNumber
request_fields.description: ID Number. Valid Values: A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example: NT1234569PM Condition : This tag is required if validation parameter set on product as CIPCollectIDNumber

request_fields.name: CollectIDCountry
request_fields.description: Country of Identification proof. Valid Values:a-z, 0-9 Example: US Refer Appendix section : Country Code Values Condition : This tag is required if validation parameter set on product as CollectIDCountry

request_fields.name: CollectIDDate
request_fields.description: ID Issue Date Format: MM/DD/YYYY Example : 09/16/2022 Condition : This tag is required if validation parameter set on product as CollectIDDate Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CollectIDExpirationDate
request_fields.description: Expiration date of ID. Format: MM/DD/YYYY Valid Values:0-9 Example:03/26/1998 Condition : This tag is required if validation parameter set on product as CollectIDExpirationDate Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CollectIDState
request_fields.description: ID Issue State Valid Values:A-Z,a-z Example:GA Appendix Section: State Codes (US) Condition : This tag is required if validation parameter set on product as CollectIDState Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: SACValue
request_fields.description: Used to hold SAC Value passed by user in input. Condition: It will be asked as per product set up Allowable Values: 14

response_fields.name: Message
response_fields.description: Returns Error Message in case of Error.

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: Returns result of API processing. If any error is found then value will be 'false' else 'true'.

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Returns Error Code in case of Error.

response_fields.name: ResponseData
response_fields.description: This is group of below data elements.

children.name: CardRegistered
children.description: Display whether card is registered or not. Valid Values: 0 = Card not registered in Self Service 1 = Card registered in Self Service Example: 0

children.name: CardLinked
children.description: Display whether card is linked with any self service user or not. Valid Values: 0 = Card not Linked with any Self Service User 1 = Card Linked with Self Service User Example: 0
